programme.title: Forensic Files: Pastoral Care
programme.desc: In 1981, New York correctional officer Donna Payant disappeared and was later found in a landfill. The medical examiner not only identified the cause of death, but also found an important clue.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bagging a Killer
programme.desc: In 1999, 9-year-old Valiree Jackson vanished on her way to school near Spokane. Her father, Brad Jackson, reported the disappearance and the entire community started searching for her abductor.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Double Trouble
programme.desc: In 1995, when off-duty Maine State Trooper Vicky Gardner is attacked by Steven Fortin during a routine stop, it triggers a chain of events which jumpstart a stalled murder case in New Jersey.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cats, Flies & Snapshots
programme.desc: When 19-year-old Lori Auker left her Pennsylvania home for work and never arrived, it took space-age technology, cat hairs and insects to pinpoint the woman's abductor.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Naked Justice
programme.desc: When Leann Fletcher is found dead, investigators use blood spatter analysis and forensic computing to find a motive for her murder: her husband, a prominent lawyer, was having an affair with judge Susan Chrzanowski.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Treading Not So Lightly
programme.desc: By using techniques she saw on forensic science TV shows, a mother determines who was responsible for the accident that permanently injured her 4-year-old daughter.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Random Targets
programme.desc: Most victims of multiple murderers are meticulously chosen because of a mutual connection with the killer or because they match an intricate set of criteria that fits the killer's MO.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Texas Rangers
programme.desc: Formed in the 1830s to protect settlers against Indian attack, the Rangers became part of the Texas Highway Patrol in 1935. Their role has continued to evolve to keep up with changing times; today it includes sophisticated forensics labs.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Invisible Death
programme.desc: Poison is an almost invisible form of death, and toxicologists must look for hidden clues in blood and tissue to bring these murders to light.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Broken Trust
programme.desc: A New York homebuyer gets more than he bargained for when a house inspection turns up a mummified corpse. For decades, the crime had gone undiscovered. The victim unmissed, and the killer unpunished.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly intentions
programme.desc: When abduction turns to murder, forensic science is the only key to finding justice for the victims of a kidnapper's deadly intentions.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Visibility Zero

programme.title: Forensic Files: Flashover
programme.desc: A fire erupts in Kings Cross Station in London, killing 31 people and injuring dozens more. Investigators pinpoint the cause of the fire, but it takes state-of-the-art technology and fluid dynamics experts to explain why it became a deadly inferno.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hack Attack
programme.desc: A mysterious computer crash pushed a thriving manufacturing company to the brink of collapse, jeopardizing hundreds of jobs. Forensic investigators had to determine if the crash was the result of a computer defect, human error, or sabotage.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Road Rage
programme.desc: Police investigate a discarded sleeping bag containing bloody sneakers and a purse, which eventually leads to the body of a young woman. A mark found on the victim's body enables police to track the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hunter or Hunted
programme.desc: A woman is killed while walking her dogs in the woods. Since she has no enemies and her husband has an alibi, police assume it's a hunting accident — until they find a strange letter, allegedly written by the woman before her death.

programme.title: Forensic Files: In Harm's Way
programme.desc: An Alaskan police officer finds a woman's body while on routine patrol of a public park. During the autopsy, the medical examiner preserves the portion of her rib cage which sustained the fatal wound.

programme.title: Forensic Files: No Corpus Delicti
programme.desc: A woman disappears without a trace. Even though foul play is suspected, the leads don't pan out and the trail turns cold. Twenty years would pass before police are able to link a clump of hair discovered in an isolated area with the missing woman.

programme.title: Forensic Files: News at 11
programme.desc: When a talented television news anchor is shot to death outside her home, it appears to be a crime of passion perpetrated by an obsessed fan.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Burning Desire
programme.desc: Investigators sift through the ashes of a fire which killed a 40-year-old woman. The fire appears to have been started by an unattended cigarette. On closer look, forensic scientists discover the cause was far more complicated.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cloak of Deceit

programme.title: Klovn: Gottegrisen

programme.title: Klovn: Tipo Napoli

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 105

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 201

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 202

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kiruna
programme.desc: Tareq arrives in Kiruna, over 200km north of the Arctic Circle. With the weather getting down to -30C, Tareq takes part in snow picnics, firing up the smoker, and using snow and ice as part of the recipes he prepares.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Bergen
programme.desc: Surrounded by some of the most beautiful landscapes in northern Europe, Bergen has become a centre for the finest seafood in northern Europe. Tareq heads into this winter wonderland to see the curious cuisine that has developed in western Norway.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: The Faroe Islands
programme.desc: Tareq comes to understand what is in the soul of the Faroese, and why their cuisine has developed the way it has. We explore the beautiful capital Torshavn and surrounding villages, and sail into a cave for a recipe prepared on a rowboat.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Central Jutland
programme.desc: Volcanoes and glaciers shaped this part of the country, leaving a giant fjord and pre-historic fossils in their wake. Farmers and food innovators work closely with nature to prepare food with the area’s plentiful herbs and award-winning seafood.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åland (Part 2)
programme.desc: Tareq goes back to Åland to explore more of this island territory. Tareq finds a chef setting up a huge food village, sees forts left over from various invaders over the centuries, and learns about beer being recreated from 200 year old DNA.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Tornedalen
programme.desc: There are not many places like Tornedalen. A rushing river has provided for locals for centuries, and the very fertile land has yielded amazing crops for centuries.Tareq explores the traditions and the food that are part of the short summer season.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Jutland
programme.desc: At the northern-most part of Denmark, you are always close to raw, beautiful nature, and incredible sunlight that has drawn artists here for over 100 years. Tareq visits a salt maker using medieval techniques and experiences the magic light of Skagen.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: East Denmark
programme.desc: East Denmark contains some of Denmark’s most fertile lands, and many traditional farmers are converting to organic production and winning awards for their cheeses and wine. Tareq bikes through an area of limestone cliffs and Viking ships.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Treading Not So Lightly
programme.desc: By using techniques she saw on forensic science TV shows, a mother determines who was responsible for the accident that permanently injured her 4-year-old daughter.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shopping Spree
programme.desc: When a woman and her daughter didn't return home from shopping, her husband directed police to a nearby mall. The child's body was found, but there was no sign of the wife.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Forever Hold Your Peace
programme.desc: When Chris Ochoa confessed to the 1988 rape and murder of Nancy DePriest, the case was closed. 8 years later, Achim Marino confessed to the same crime. Can DNA evidence identify the real perpetrator?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Reel Danger
programme.desc: When two boys are brutally attacked, investigators rely on evidence fished out of a nearby pond. It became the first case where diatom analysis was used to place a suspect at the scene of the crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Who's Your Daddy
programme.desc: In 1988, the body of a young woman was discovered in an Ohio river. Most of the evidence had been washed away, but the victim's 6-year-old son unwittingly told investigators all they needed to know — without saying a word. The clue was in his genes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Alibi
programme.desc: In 1991, a high school girl vanished after attending a party. The prime suspect had two alibi witnesses for the night she disappeared. A solid alibi can often overcome circumstantial evidence, but forensic evidence is another matter.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Purr-fect Match
programme.desc: When police discovered the body of Douglas Beamish's estranged wife, authorities linked 20 cat hairs found on her jacket to a cat owned by Beamish's parents. It was the first time animal DNA was used to solve a criminal case.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bio-Attack
programme.desc: When more than 700 Oregonians contracted food poisoning from a unique strain of salmonella in 1984, investigators uncovered a secret plot to influence local elections.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Shot in the Dark
programme.desc: Two sets of scientists probe a woman's death.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Without a Prayer
programme.desc: In 1995, the founder of American Atheists disappeared with one of her sons, her granddaughter and $500,000 in gold coins. The police investigated several suspects, including David R. Waters, who worked for American Atheists.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The True Story of Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: Philadelphia, Mississippi, 1964. A sleepy southern town steeped in tradition finds itself targeted for invasion.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Polly Klaas: Kidnapped
programme.desc: On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly intentions

programme.title: The New Detectives: Traces Of Guilt
programme.desc: Sometimes the scales of justice are balanced by just a few milligrams of evidence: a couple of fibers, a tooth filling, or a smudge on a piece of tape. The biggest cases are often solved by the smallest clues.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Soldier Stories
programme.desc: This show profiles the work of world-renowned forensic experts as they work to tell the stories of the young men who went to war (from the French and Indian war to Vietnam) and never came back.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Vanished

programme.title: The New Detectives: Undaunted
programme.desc: Solving crimes may begin with gut intuition, but advanced science provides investigators with irrefutable proof. When criminals go to great lengths to mask their crimes, investigators must step up the challenge and remain forever undaunted.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bad Medicine

programme.title: Forensic Files: Stick 'Em Up
programme.desc: Residents of Noel, Missouri were stunned to learn that their bank had been robbed and the bank president was missing. His body was later found floating in a lake, securely bound to a chair with duct tape.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Making the Collar

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Financial Downfall

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Haunted by the disappearance of her mother, a young woman undertakes an investigation of her own. In her mother's diary, she discovers a dark family secret that might explain the disappearance.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Over a Barrel

programme.title: Forensic Files: Pinned by the Evidence

programme.title: South Park: Du börjar att bli gammal
programme.desc: Stan får en tween wave-cd på födelsedagen och hans föräldrar förbjuder honom att lyssna på 'sånt skit'. Stan börjar hålla med sina föräldrar men hans kamrater är inte imponerade.

programme.title: South Park: Rövburgare
programme.desc: Stan är fortfarande inne i en livskris, medan Cartman börjar sälja hamburgare med en superduperhemlig specialingrediens.

programme.title: South Park: Stanleys Cup
programme.desc: Stan blir tränare för ett hockeylag med småpojkar och försöker göra dem till ett vinnande lag.

programme.title: South Park: Crème Fraiche
programme.desc: Randy blir helt besatt av matkanalen, så Sharon tvingas att hitta en egen hobby.

programme.title: South Park: Russin
programme.desc: Wendy dumpar Stan och han blir depprockare för att kunna leva ut sin smärta.

programme.title: South Park: Allt om mormonerna?
programme.desc: En ny kille, Gary, anländer till South Park och hans familj är mormoner. Eric blir vän med honom men blir besviken på den mormonska berättelsen.

programme.title: South Park: South Parks fantastiska påskspecial
programme.desc: Stan bestämmer sig för att ta reda på anledningen bakom målade påskägg och upptäcker en hemlighet om den katolska kyrkan.

programme.title: South Park: Vulkanen
programme.desc: Pojkarna ger sig ut på jakt med Stans galne farbror Jimbo. De vet emellertid inte att berget de jagar på är en vulkan som är på väg att få utbrott.

programme.title: South Park: Fettläger
programme.desc: Mrs Cartman anordnar en intervention för att avbryta sin sons matproblem och skickar honom på ett läger där han ska gå ner i vikt.

programme.title: South Park: 1%
programme.desc: De 99 % gaddar ihop sig mot Eric Cartman.

programme.title: South Park: Människobjörngrisen
programme.desc: Medan de hjälper f.d. vicepresidenten Al Gore att få mer uppmärksamhet fastnar pojkarna i en grotta. När de letar efter en väg ut upptäcker Cartman en skatt.

programme.title: South Park: Tamponger av Cherokeehår
programme.desc: Kyle behöver en njurtransplantation och Cartman är en perfekt donator, men Cartman sätter ett högt pris på sin njure: 10 miljoner dollar.

programme.title: South Park: Dansar med smurfar
programme.desc: Cartman blir utnämnd till att läsa upp morgonnyheterna i högtalarna på South Park Elementary.

programme.title: South Park: Weight Gain 4000
programme.desc: Cartman vinner en uppsatstävling genom att fuska. Mr Garrison planerar att döda Kathy Lee Gifford som ska presentera prisutdelningen.

programme.title: South Park: Scott Tenorman måste dö
programme.desc: Cartman blir ursinnig på Scott Tenorman när rödhårige Scott lurar vår medgörlige hjälte att köpa hans pubeshår för 6,12 dollar.

programme.title: South Park: Medicinsk grillad kyckling
programme.desc: Cartmans favoritrestaurang stänger, och istället öppnar en affär för medicinsk marijuana. Randy försöker desperat få det utskrivet på recept, medan Cartman desperat försöker få tillbaka sin älskade grillade kyckling.

programme.title: South Park: Dum och fattig

programme.title: South Park: Strejk

programme.title: South Park: Den siste meheecanen
programme.desc: Pojkarna leker gränspoliser, men det går överstyr och Butters blir hjälte i Mexiko när han återuppväcker den mexikanska stolheten. Men Cartman tänker inte låta leken sluta där.

programme.title: South Park: Marjorine

programme.title: Star Trek: The Original Series
programme.desc: The Enterprise must escort an alien princess to her marriage to seal an interplanetary alliance. In their journey, she becomes attracted to Kirk.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Original Series
programme.desc: Kirk and Spock deliver medicine to an insane asylum where a former Starfleet captain is being held. They discover that he has freed the inmates and is running the place.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Original Series
programme.desc: The Enterprise hosts two alien beings from the same planet who share an intense and self-destructive hatred of each other.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Without a Prayer
programme.desc: In 1995, the founder of American Atheists disappeared with one of her sons, her granddaughter and $500,000 in gold coins. The police investigated several suspects, including David R. Waters, who worked for American Atheists.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Clutch of Witnesses
programme.desc: Two eyewitnesses may hold the key to the death of a motorcycle gang member.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Scout's Honor
programme.desc: In 1984, a passerby finds the torso of a woman in a cardboard box. A forensic entomologist analyzes nearby insect activity to determine when the victim was killed.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Touching Recollection
programme.desc: The investigation into the kidnapping and rape of an 18-year-old Ohio woman is aided when the victim returns hours after the incident occurred. With her help, the police are able to track the assailant to his front door.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Leg to Stand On
programme.desc: The police investigate when a severed leg is discovered among garbage. Conventional means of identifying the victim are impossible, leading investigators to rely on DNA, forensic anthropology and toxicology.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Partners in Crime
programme.desc: In a 1992 murder case, the autopsy of a cremated body turns up telltale clues of foul play.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Within a Hair
programme.desc: In 1996, Indiana police identified Richard Alexander as the “River Park Rapist” who assaulted four women that year. Later, DNA analysis casts doubt on his conviction.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Chief Evidence
programme.desc: After the 1996 murder of Seattle residents Raquel Rivera and Jay Johnson, evidence from the couple's dog eventually ties one of the murderers to the scene.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Bitter Pill to Swallow
programme.desc: Soon after becoming pregnant by Dr. Maynard Muntzing, firefighter Michelle Baker's health quickly deteriorates. Eventually, she raises suspicions that Muntzing is doing her harm.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sip of Sins
programme.desc: In the 1980s, a trio of unsolved murders occurred in Wichita Falls, Texas. Later, a fourth murder from the same time period provided the police with far more than they realized.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Telltale Tracks
programme.desc: The disappearance of Philadelphia college athlete Aimee Willard is investigated after her car is found on the roadside. When her body is found, the police find unusual marks and DNA evidence that eventually lead to her killer.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey
programme.desc: Thomas Dillon killed five outdoorsmen at random over a period of three years in rural southern Ohio. After a tip led the FBI to the murder weapon, ballistic testing made a match.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska
programme.desc: The day began like any other for Cheryl and Paul Chapman, until the silence of a peaceful Sunday morning was shattered with a phone call.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The New Detectives: Undaunted
programme.desc: Solving crimes may begin with gut intuition, but advanced science provides investigators with irrefutable proof. When criminals go to great lengths to mask their crimes, investigators must step up the challenge and remain forever undaunted.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Dealings
programme.desc: For a price, anything's possible. Contract killings arose out of the need to establish the perfect alibi. By hiring someone else to do the dirty work, a person can deflect guilt, at least in theory.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lethal Encounter
programme.desc: In most homicides, police rely on motive to pursue a murderer. But when the killer is a stranger the crime may go unsolved for years. It takes a full arsenal of forensic techniques to trace a lethal encounter.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Presumed Dead
programme.desc: What does it take to prove murder if the victim cannot be found? Investigators must go to extreme lengths to catch the killer when the victim is presumed dead.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Chemistry
programme.desc: The show examines cases of poison and deadly chemistry and shows how forensic experts are solving mysterious deaths today and from the past.

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Wife Discovers Husband's Secret Family

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Jerry Rescues An Obese Man

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: I Have A Secret For My Man!
programme.desc: Friends Tatiana and Latasha have both been keeping a big secret from their boyfriends! Today they're here to come clean!

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Murder Haunts Me
programme.desc: A young mother-to-be is shot and left for dead. To catch her assailant, Kenda must elicit a death-bed confession from the victim herself.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: The Invisible Hand of Death
programme.desc: Two teens stumble upon a woman engulfed in flames, leaving detectives to wonder just who in her inner circle could kill so cruelly.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: A Beautiful Shade of Death
programme.desc: When police discover the lifeless bodies of Sophia Gerardo, four children and a house cat, they suspect ritualistic mass murder. But Lt. Joe Kenda uncovers a reality far more frightening.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Blood Relative

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: John 3:16

programme.title: Forensic Files: Buried Treasure
programme.desc: A man disappears one year to the day after beginning an affair with his friend's wife. 15 years later, with the help of a metal detector, police find evidence that would prove what had happened and who was responsible.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Badge of Betrayal
programme.desc: When the body of a young woman is found under an isolated highway ramp, a unique fiber on the victim's clothing leads San Diego police straight to the most unlikely of killers.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Matrimony
programme.desc: A go-go dancer told her family she needed to get away for a while and then she simply disappeared. Investigators were suspicious, because she took neither her car nor her clothes. 20 years later, her family received a call that changed everything.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Muddy Waters
programme.desc: A Colorado hunter is the victim of a well-planned crime. Investigators suspect two weapons and two killers. But forensic evidence points them in a different direction — one much closer to home.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Point of Origin
programme.desc: In 1984, California firefighters battled ten arson fires in three weeks. When cigarettes and a scrap of paper connected the case to similar fires further north, the hunt was on for a dangerous pyromaniac.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Seeds for Doubt
programme.desc: In 2002, a small community in upstate New York was devastated when Patty Wlasiuk died in a truck accident. But burdock seed pods found in her hair and on her clothes indicated that this was no accident — it was cold-blooded murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Saving Face
programme.desc: When a woman disappeared without a trace, there were two possible explanations: kidnapping or murder. Careful investigation, a forensic artist and DNA profiling enabled police to find a single suspect, who was known to prey upon vulnerable women.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Northern Exposure
programme.desc: Alaskan hikers discover a body wrapped in sheets which were edged in orange stitching. Investigators find a tuft of red carpet fibers clinging to the sheet — threads of evidence which lead them straight to the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Silk Stalkings
programme.desc: Prompted by news of a flight attendant's brutal murder, the son of a previous victim contacts police. Both murders have similar MOs, and biological evidence proves that these were serial killings.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fishing for the Truth
programme.desc: A two-man shrimp boat sinks when a fast-moving, violent storm strikes the Louisiana coast. The captain drowns, but the deckhand is rescued fourteen hours later. The crewman is hailed as a hero — until the captain's body is discovered.

programme.title: Forensic Files: For Love or Money
programme.desc: When a wealthy real estate tycoon goes missing, it appears to be foul play. In his will, he leaves instructions in case he should die under violent circumstances — which were carried out after a hiker comes across his bullet-ridden skull.

programme.desc: Lauren och Audrina åker till Cabo för Brodys födelsedag, men när Justin blir svartsjuk över Audrinas nya förhållande urartar festen i bråk. Spencer förödmjukar Stephanie när har får veta att hennes nya kille är kompis med Brody.

programme.title: The Hills: I Want You To Be With Me
programme.desc: Lauren försöker skipa fred mellan Brody och Stephanie. Audrina vill att det ska funka med Corey, men Justin vägrar ge upp. Stephanie undrar om hennes nya kille verkligen är nåt att ha när han bryter sitt löfte att stå på sig inför Brody.

programme.title: The Hills: It's Her Move
programme.desc: Audrina flyttar till ett eget ställe i hopp om att Justin ska flytta ihop med henne, men alla är oroliga att hon flyttar av fel skäl. Heidi bjuder Spencer på ett jobbevenemang och ertappas på bar gärning med att ha lite för kul.

programme.title: The Hills: Back To New York
programme.desc: Whitney reser till New York och förväntar sig att träffa Alex, men får i stället upp ögonen för Jay. Heidi är deppad över att ha fått sparken, men när Spencer går till Brent i ett försök att hjälpa henne få jobbet tillbaka gör han saken etter värre.

programme.title: The Hills: One Last Chance
programme.desc: Lauren låter Heidis syster sova över hos henne. Justin bjuder Audrina på en romantisk helgresa och Heidis frustration över Spencer växer när hon måste böna och be om att få jobbet tillbaka.

programme.title: The Hills: You Did This
programme.desc: Audrina tror på ett rykte hon får höra: Att Lauren har haft ihop det med Justin. Samtidigt försöker Holly hålla Heidi och Spencer åtskilda.

programme.title: The Hills: It's About Trust
programme.desc: Audrina försöker rädda sin vänskap med Lauren efter att ha anklagat henne för att ha haft ihop det med Justin. Spencer och Stephanie besöker sin mormor som är trött på allt deras bråk.

programme.title: The Hills: Dream Boy, Dream Job
programme.desc: Whitney har chansen att få sitt drömjobb i New York och hoppas att träffa Jay där. Lauren blir nostalgisk när hennes föräldrar säljer sitt hus i Laguna Beach. Stephanie vänder sig till Spencer för hjälp när hon inte vet vad hon ska göra med Cameron.

programme.title: The Hills: Mr. & Mrs. Pratt
programme.desc: Spencer och Heidi struntar i deras familjers farhågor och flyr till Mexiko för att gifta sig. Whitney satsar på ett drömjobb i New York och tar farväl av Lauren och sitt liv i Los Angeles.

programme.title: The Hills: I Heidi Take Thee Spencer
programme.desc: Lauren och Heidi lägger osämjan åt sidan och minns varför de var vänner. Spencer och Heidi måste ta itu med det hemliga giftermålet när Heidis mamma hälsar på. Audrina får en chock när Justin tar med henne till Palm Springs för en överraskning.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 2805
programme.desc: På Als bor Frida och Charly i en stor lägenhet med sin älskade hund Balder som de skämmer bort. De drömmer om att köpa en gård på landet, men just nu kan de inte ens betala elräkningen.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 2704
programme.desc: Dorte, 29, bor i Valby med sin son Liam. Dorte har en historia av cannabismissbruk och en stor del av hennes skulder härrör från detta. Hon är rädd för att öppna brevlådan och fruktar att hennes skulder kommer att drabba Liam.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 2503
programme.desc: Åke, 27, har sitt eget företag, men hans enda kund har precis avslutat samarbetet eftersom Åke inte ens orkar gå upp på morgonen - och det är långt ifrån det enda problemet med företaget ...

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark
programme.desc: Henriette och Jacob från Brørups många flyttar lämnar ett långt spår av obetalda räkningar. De har också gått in och ut ur många kurser och tagit SU-lån.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark
programme.desc: Daniels relation till pengar är så impulsiv och behovsstyrd att den har äventyrat hans förhållande till hans gravida flickvän. På ett år har han spenderat 55.000 kr på snabbmat, bensin och mat som levereras till dörren.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark
programme.desc: Svenska Emelie har haft några tuffa år. Hennes år av alkohol- och spelberoende har inte bara kostat henne dyrt i privatlivet. Hon är också skyldig pengar till höger och vänster.

programme.desc: 1970s Z-Flex Jimmy Plumer Poolrider skateboard with artwork by Doug Smith; Kevlar bulletproof vest, ballistic facemask and a helmet used by S.W.A.T. teams; a pair of 1990s racing pocket bikes capable of going 80 mph.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Cold Hard Cash
programme.desc: Ton and Allen go North to Alaska and get a cold reception from the local auctioneer. They find two enormous seaplane pontoons and a pair of Smith & Wesson revolvers, including the most powerful production handgun in the world!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Hot Wheels
programme.desc: '70s sand rail dune racer with rally hemi heads; 1965 replica Mustang pool table; off-road racing gear.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ton's Driller Instinct
programme.desc: Ton & Allen encounter aggressive outdoorsmen in the Alaskan wilderness. The guys discover an 8-wheeled ATV that travels on both land & water and an air percussion hammer that can drill through solid rock!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Allen's Ruff Day
programme.desc: Ton and Allen head to an auction in Ton's hometown and end up battling with a big-mouthed buyer. They discover a pair of tranquilizer dart guns and also end up fighting with a K9!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Choo-Choo, Cha-Ching!
programme.desc: Ton and Allen get a surprise second chance after nearly getting shut out in the small town of Palmer. They uncover a motorized railroad maintenance car from the 1960's and a pre-WWI Japanese semi-automatic pistol.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Early Bird Special
programme.desc: Vintage Shooting Star carnival game; professional Mixed Martial Arts octagon fighting cage.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Hidden Hot Wheels
programme.desc: Ton and Allen challenge a big time auction buyer on his home turf. The guys uncover a 1969 Chevelle Malibu muscle car and a single-shot pistol designed to aid Allied resistance fighters during WWII.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Night of the Digging Dead
programme.desc: A custom-built shark cage; 1900s pathologist's dissection toolkit; 1940s embalming pump and one of the first electric bone saws.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Shuffle
programme.desc: Ton and Allen teach a cocky new auction hunter a lesson. They spot a 1940's-era shuffleboard table and uncover an early hot rod made from the fuel tank of a WWII fighter plane!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Wild West
programme.desc: Allen and Ton explain their strategies at a storage auction in San Bernardino, win two units, then have a Pepperbox gun and vintage Lionel train set appraised by experts.

programme.title: Siesta Key: I Just Didn't Think It Was Going To Happen So Fast
programme.desc: Juliette försöker gå vidare genom att jobba. Madisson är trött på att Chloe lägger sig i allt och bestämmer sig för att flytta. Kelseys ex kommer tillbaka och ställer till det för henne och Garrett.

programme.title: Teen Mom 2: Life Goes On
programme.desc: Leah försöker komma in på sjuksköterskeutbildningen, Chelsea blir erbjuden en biljett till en Dierks Bentley-konsert för att hon ska glömma Adam. Jenelle får sona för sina brott, Kailyn drar Jo inför rätta över vårdnaden.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Someone's Getting Dumped
programme.desc: Amelia återvänder till huset, James och Louis slåss om Roxy, och singlarna får chockerande nyheter.

programme.desc: I ett nytt avsnitt av Ridiculousness hälsar Rob och Steelo Brittney Elena välkommen när de fastnar i 'Stängselfällor' lär sig slappna av med 'Generation för chill' och tar en närmare titt på folk som visar ömhet öppet i 'Vår unika kärlek'.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Avsnitt 601
programme.desc: 10 nya kändisar flyttar in på Camp Kulinaris. Här kommer de att bo tillsammans och samtidigt driva sin egen restaurang under ledning av mästerkocken Kjartan Skjelde.

programme.desc: Gänget är redan i gång i köket och redan från början gör litermåtten det svårt för Raylee att laga mat. Samtidigt visar sig kombinationen av Mutta och lågor vara en dålig idé.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Avsnitt 603

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Avsnitt 605
programme.desc: Det är en ny vecka på Camp Kulinaris och deltagarna har redan blivit en sammansvetsad grupp som tycker om varandras sällskap. Alla är spända på att se vem som blir veckans restaurangchef.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Avsnitt 606

programme.desc: För första gången i programmets historia har både mor och dotter hamnat i en plastikkirurgi-mardröm. Nu söker de tillsammans hjälp.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Geordie Fest
programme.desc: Hela huset firar Abbies 21-årsdag med en fest som huset sällan skådat - och självklart bjuder de Abbies momor! Familjen delar en gråtmild stund när deras tid tillsammans kommer till ett slut.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: All Change In The House
programme.desc: Geordisarna är tillbaka! Men denna gång slänger Anna och Scotty T in fyra nykomlingar. De gör sitt bästa för att passa in men gamlingarna finns alltid tillgängliga för att visa dem hur man festar!

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Nathan Needs A House Party
programme.desc: När Nathan deppar ner sig bestämmer sig familjen för att ha fest för att muntra upp honom. Sophie saknar sin pojkvän medan nykomlingarna gör sig hemmastadda. Abbie sätter käppar i hjulet för Beau och Bethan.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Beau & Bethan Get It On!
programme.desc: Nathan och Chloe mår inte bra och tjejerna har förfest utan att bjuda in honom. Trots att han inte är ute efter nåt förhållande dras Beau till Bethan och de får ihop det.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Buckle Up! The Geordies Hit Belfast!
programme.desc: Anna berättar för gänget att de ska till Belfast. Geordisarna njuter av allt vad staden har att erbjuda. Tahlia raggar till och med upp en servitör! Men se går allt åt skogen när Chloes och Sams förhållande når botten och de tar paus.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: From the First Fist Pump
programme.desc: Det blir en återblick på de första tre säsongerna av Jersey Shore - med alla dråpligheter, allt drama och alla upptåg som folk har snackat om.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Going to Italia
programme.desc: Vännerna packar ner sitt löshår och sina Shore Store-tröjor och flyger iväg till Italien för ett europeiskt äventyr. Men kulturchocken som väntar dem är ingenting i jämförelse med deras chockerande nya romanser.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Like More than a Friend
programme.desc: Deena och Pauly överväger konsekvenserna av att ha sex, medan Mike försöker ta sin vänskap med Snooki till nästa nivå. Ron och Sammi försöker bli vänner, men det visar sig att gamla vanor, bra som dåliga, är svåra att bryta.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Twinning
programme.desc: Med tvillingar som extra ingrediens blir det dubbelt trubbel då bi-nyfikna Deena utsätter både Mike OCH Vinny för rån. Mikes hemliga hångel med Snooki avslöjas. Är Snooki otrogen eller försöker The Situation bara skapa drama?

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Crime and Punishment
programme.desc: Pojkarna mobbar Deena när hon stjäl en tjej från Vinnys säng, vilket får henne att känna obehag och tvivla på sin relation till vännerna. Ronnie och Sam återgår till gamla vanor, men den här gången är Mike inblandad i deras röra.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: And the Wall Won
programme.desc: Efter att Mike orsakat dramatik mellan Ron och Sammi i flera år blir det bråk mellan Mike och Ronnie. Men när Mike bärs ut på bår undrar man om det inte gått för långt. Och är Sam och Ronnies förhållande bortom räddning?

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Fist Pump, Pushups, Chapstick
programme.desc: Pauly och Vinny anordnar en komedishow med guido-tema, medan Ron och Sammi återigen försöker lappa ihop sitt förhållande. Snooki blir så stressad av sitt instabila långdistansförhållande att Jenni och Sam beslutar sig för att ingripa.

programme.title: Casualty 24/7: Episode 13
programme.desc: The staff at Barnsley casualty are enjoying an unusually peaceful start to the day and superstition dictates that on days like this, there’s one word that must never be uttered - the Q word!

programme.title: Casualty 24/7: Episode 14
programme.desc: There’s a new Matron in charge at Barnsley Casualty today - it’s Hannah’s first day in her new role but it’s not going to be an easy one. The department is completely full, there’s no movement and patients just keep on arriving.

programme.title: Casualty 24/7: Episode 15
programme.desc: The first heatwave of summer has hit Barnsley and it’s adding to the pressure of an already stressful day in casualty for Sister Jane who’s in charge today. The department is hot, stuffy, and bursting with patients all needing emergency treatment.

programme.title: Casualty 24/7: Episode 16
programme.desc: It’s another relentless shift for the team at Barnsley casualty and running the hub today is Sister Jane. Staff are struggling to meet the 15-minute assessment target time but doing all they can.

programme.title: Casualty 24/7: Episode 17
programme.desc: It’s a big day at Barnsley Casualty, for the first time since the Covid pandemic hit the UK, staff can finally remove their masks. For some it’s a happy, welcome relief, but others aren’t ready to go mask-free just yet.

programme.title: Dirty Home Rescue: Episode 1
programme.desc: In this brand-new series of Dirty Home Rescue, Hayley Leitch and her cleaning team Tom Swire and Chesley Medley-Brown go to the rescue of Toni from Telford whose house is so dirty her partner of 10 years, Rich, won’t move in with her.

programme.title: Dirty Home Rescue: Episode 2
programme.desc: Hayley Leitch and her cleaning team Tom Swire and Chesley Medley-Brown go to the rescue of Bill and Antionette from Newport, who share their home with their 3 cats. They admit they’ve not deep cleaned their home since they moved in.

programme.title: Hoarders: Episode 5
programme.desc: Paul's hoard fills his whole house, room after room after room is buried under 6 feet of clutter.

programme.title: Hoarders: Episode 1
programme.desc: In the picturesque city of Bath, Paul’s cottage is bursting at the seams with a lifetime’s collection of junk. Known locally as ‘boot cottage’ - because everything Paul owns and wears comes from car boot sales - every room is a no-go zone.

programme.title: Hoarders: Episode 2
programme.desc: In Harlow, 63-year-old Bubbles’ high-rise flat is packed with piles of junk she can’t bear to throw away. But it doesn’t end there she also has a staggering 4 lock ups stuffed to the gills with rubbish.

programme.title: Hoarders: Episode 3
programme.desc: In Mansfield Sue’s hoard is driving her family and grandchildren away and her husband Neil to distraction. Every room is crammed with clutter including a bedroom that looks more like a dolls graveyard than somewhere to sleep.

programme.title: Trucking Hell: Episode 6
programme.desc: Incident Manager Steve is sent to coordinate a recovery on the Northbound A1 after a collision that has closed both lanes. With a Bin Lorry on its side in a ditch and a truck pulling a refrigerated container rolled over, this is a major job.

programme.title: Trucking Hell: Episode 7
programme.desc: On the M1, Crouch incident manager, Steve, and his team face a massive task trying to recover a 26-ton lorry that careened off the motorway, catapulted across a 6-foot ditch, broke through a fence, and landed a shocking 30 meters from the road.

programme.title: Trucking Hell: Episode 8
programme.desc: Steve and the team attempt to rescue an enormous rubble truck that's tipped over in a ditch. Forced to close the road they're up against the clock, but having to work in the dark is making the job a lot more precarious.

programme.title: Trucking Hell: Episode 9
programme.desc: Stig is called out to an oil tanker stuck in the mud in the middle of an isolated farm track. Stig is forced to reverse his massive truck through the surrounding tiny lanes to try and reach the stranded truck from the other side.

programme.title: Trucking Hell
programme.desc: Tez and the team get in a jam when they recover a parcel lorry that has taken the term 'stuck in the post' to another level. They have the risky job of getting it shifted before rush hour begins.

programme.title: Trucking Hell: Episode 11
programme.desc: A delivery truck's in hot water, cab first into a pond, and its recovery ops Sean and Michael in at the deep end, figuring out how to extract a 38-ton delivery lorry from its watery grave.

programme.title: Mannen som talar med hundar: Hyde & Vada and Nacho
programme.desc: Hyde and Vada, both wolf hybrids have aggression issues to work out especially when it comes to other dogs. Nacho, bit a child, and shows aggression when he has his toy.

programme.title: Mannen som talar med hundar: Sadie and Calder
programme.desc: Allen and Erin Carrasco ‘s Basset Hound Sadie whines and moans whenever Allen is around. Blue Heeler mix Calder is a great dog by day, but bedtime rituals unleash unwelcome night terrors.

programme.title: Mannen som talar med hundar: Chihuahuas from Hell
